banners.prompt:
Create a NEW, finished Facebook/Instagram feed advertising banner for a Bulgarian audience, from scratch.
IMAGE 1 is only a blank grey canvas used for size: ignore its content completely. The photo/background must fill the WHOLE frame edge to edge (no bars, no borders, no frames).
LAYOUT SAFE ZONE (critical): the top 14% and the bottom 14% of the frame will be cut off afterwards. Put NOTHING important there - only continuation of the background. ALL text lines, faces, the book and the CTA button must be inside the middle 72% of the frame height. Keep about 6% side margins for text.
COMPOSITION NOTE: frame the shot wide enough that there is calm empty background above the headline and below the CTA button. The headline starts around 18-20% from the top; the CTA button sits around 80-86% and is fully visible with space under it.
EXACT VERTICAL LAYOUT (percent of the full frame height, measured from the top): 0-15% only background. 16-32% the headline. 33-76% the notebook page with the handwritten list. 80-87% the CTA button. 88-100% only background. Do not put any text or the button outside these zones.
FORMAT: UGLY - a raw, handmade-looking banner (IMAGE 2 is a winning UGLY banner: copy its raw notebook/marker feel, not its text). No book, no person.
The setting is a real, modest seaside town in Northern Greece (like Asprovalta, Stavros, Paralia Katerini or Nea Peramos): ordinary white/ochre apartment buildings with balconies, bougainvillea, laundry lines, the blue Aegean sea in the distance. Not Santorini, not a luxury resort. The people are Bulgarian property owners around 55-65 years old, natural and likeable.
SCENE: top-down photo of an open lined paper notebook on a weathered wooden balcony table, the blue sea and a balcony railing softly blurred at the edges; a bunch of apartment keys with a small blue-and-white keychain, a glass of iced frappe coffee and a pen beside the notebook. On the notebook page, handwritten in blue ballpoint, four short lines one under another, each with a red question mark after it: "майсторът?", "сметката за ток?", "домоуправителят?", "съседите?".
TEXT ON THE BANNER (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Headline in heavy black condensed letters on a white paper strip at the top of the central zone, two lines: "Имаш апартамент в Гърция, но не говориш гръцки?" - with a yellow highlighter behind "не говориш гръцки?".
2) CTA button: "ВИЖ КАК →"
TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic. Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character, including punctuation and quotation marks. Do not translate, correct, shorten, re-order or add any words.
- Use a heavy, clean, condensed sans-serif for headlines (like Oswald Bold / Bebas-style weight but with full Cyrillic), unless the format below says otherwise.
- Text must be large and clearly legible on a phone at 380px width: headline lines at least ~6% of the banner height, subheadline ~3.5%, CTA text ~3.5%. Keep generous side margins (about 6% of the width).
- Strong contrast only: white or near-black text; accent words in warm yellow #F5C518; no grey text on dark backgrounds.
- CTA = rounded pill button in vivid red #E8232A with bold white uppercase text and an arrow →, centred near the bottom of the central area.
- No other text, logos, watermarks, prices of the book, percentages or website addresses anywhere.

PHOTO STYLE: realistic, natural-looking photo like a real Bulgarian everyday scene taken with a good phone camera; natural light, real skin texture; not glossy stock, no beauty filter. People have only two hands with five fingers each.

CRITICAL POSITION CHECK: the FIRST line of any text must start no higher than 17% of the frame height from the top. The CTA button must end no lower than 87% of the frame height.
NO extra text anywhere in the scene: no posters, signs, wall lettering or written papers besides the book cover.
